libsodium.js 0.8.4 (ISC; libsodium itself ISC): libsodium.js and libsodium-wrappers.js, from npm, unmodified.
livekit-client 2.23.0 (Apache-2.0): livekit-client.umd.js and livekit-client.e2ee.worker.js, from npm, unmodified.
The phone app (the Room in a browser) uses them for its encryption and its calls.
